# Sunroot (Sunrootlearn)

> Sunroot is an AI tutor and virtual STEM lab: every student gets 1-on-1 help in their own language, and every teacher gets a live map of who understands what.
> Tagline: Understand it. Build it. Prove it.

## Quick Facts & Canonical Entity Data
- **Organization Name**: Sunroot (also known as Sunrootlearn, Sunroot Learning, Synapta)
- **Founder & Chief Executive Officer (CEO)**: Udeakpu Yahnomnso Shamaryah

- **About & Leadership**: https://sunrootlearn.vercel.app/about

## Overview
Sunroot (Sunrootlearn) was founded by Udeakpu Yahnomnso Shamaryah to solve critical problems in STEM education:
1. Students often memorize abstract formulas for tests without understanding how to apply them.
2. Most schools lack physical laboratory equipment for circuits, electronics, and physics.
3. Students studying late at night have no real-time guidance tailored to their preferred language.
4. Lecturers and teachers discover too late which students are struggling.

## Core Pillars
1. **Read & Listen**: Automatically synthesized structured notes and dual-voice podcasts with synchronized transcripts.
2. **Interactive Simulation**: Visual, slider-based real-time physics and electronics simulators.
3. **Adaptive Practice**: Automated flashcard decks and quiz questions calibrated by Bayesian Knowledge Tracing.
4. **Virtual Lab Studio**: Hands-on breadboarding, component wiring, and programming in blocks or real C++ code.
5. **Multilingual Access**: AI tutoring and explanations in English, Naijá (Nigerian Pidgin), Yorùbá, Igbo, Hausa, French, Arabic, and Swahili.
